t: A man who sinned three times and was forgiven three times
a: أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي
p: A-ʿalima ʿabdī anna lahu rabban yaghfiru-dh-dhanba wa yaʾkhudhu bih, ghafartu li-ʿabdī
m: My servant knew that he has a Lord who forgives sin and who holds people to account for it. I have forgiven My servant.
